in_sanskrit.name: Arjish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave and Fearless
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arj' meaning 'thunder' and 'ish' meaning 'lord'. This name is attributed to Arjuna from the Mahabharata, who was known for his bravery and unwavering devotion to his duty and teacher. Arjuna's name was given to him by Lord Krishna, who saw his potential and recognized his unwavering resolve.
